tactics: rename_i b d a c hb hd hab hdc

rename_i b d a c hb hd hab hdc <;> obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hab <;> obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hdc <;> rw [show b * k * d + b * (d * m) = b * d * (k + m) by simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm]] <;> simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero, *]
